Founding member offer

30% off the first 12 months for eligible enrollments completed by December 31, 2026. After the first 12 months, membership renews at the regular V2 price unless canceled.

Enrollment remains closed until secure account, payment, member access, support and cancellation work together.

How joining will work

  1. Find and review your public profile.
  2. Verify appropriate authority through the secure member account.
  3. Choose Individual, Team or Office membership; Enterprise remains quote-only.
  4. Complete your richer profile and first-value onboarding.
  5. Manage payment method and cancellation through self-service account tools.

Important boundaries

  • Membership does not buy factual accuracy or ordinary directory rank.
  • A member mark indicates community participation, not certification or endorsement.
  • No membership guarantees leads, customers, revenue or outcomes.
  • A payment redirect alone can never activate membership.

Enrollment is still fail-closed.

No payment can be made on Franklin Navigator today. The payment-to-member-access lifecycle has been implemented and tested in R23, but live activation waits for Franklin's own durable server-side store and accepted production evidence.
